# ResearchGate
> ResearchGate is a professional network for researchers to share publications, discover research, ask questions, and connect with peers.

ResearchGate combines researcher profiles, publication pages, project spaces, Q&A, jobs, and institutional information to support academic discovery and collaboration across disciplines.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.researchgate.net/): Main entry point to ResearchGate’s research discovery and academic networking platform.
- [Login](https://www.researchgate.net/login): Sign in to access profiles, publications, questions, and collaboration features.
- [Signup](https://www.researchgate.net/signup): Create a ResearchGate account for sharing work and connecting with researchers.
- [About](https://www.researchgate.net/about): Overview of ResearchGate’s mission, platform purpose, and researcher community.
- [Press](https://www.researchgate.net/press): Company news, announcements, and media resources about ResearchGate.
- [Careers](https://www.researchgate.net/careers): Open roles and information about working at ResearchGate.

## Research Discovery
- [Publications](https://www.researchgate.net/publication): Browse publication records and research outputs shared on the platform.
- [Questions](https://www.researchgate.net/questions): Explore research questions and community answers across scientific topics.
- [Jobs](https://www.researchgate.net/jobs): Search academic and research-related job opportunities posted on ResearchGate.
- [Topics](https://www.researchgate.net/topic): Discover subject areas, topic pages, and related research content.
- [Authors](https://www.researchgate.net/profile): Find researcher profiles, publication lists, and academic activity.
- [Institutions](https://www.researchgate.net/institution): Explore universities, labs, and research organizations represented on the platform.

## Researcher Profiles
- [Profile Directory](https://www.researchgate.net/profile): Directory of researcher profile pages and academic identities.
- [People Search](https://www.researchgate.net/search/researcher): Search for researchers by name, affiliation, or field.
- [Followers](https://www.researchgate.net/followers): Access follower and network-related profile connections when signed in.
- [Following](https://www.researchgate.net/following): View followed researchers, topics, and content sources when signed in.
- [Stats](https://www.researchgate.net/stats): Research activity and readership statistics for signed-in users.

## Publications and Contributions
- [Add New Research](https://www.researchgate.net/add-publication): Add a publication record or research contribution to a profile.
- [Upload](https://www.researchgate.net/upload): Upload full texts and associated files for eligible research outputs.
- [Citations](https://www.researchgate.net/citations): View citation-related information and publication impact data when available.
- [Reads](https://www.researchgate.net/reads): Access readership metrics and engagement information for shared research.
- [Recommendations](https://www.researchgate.net/recommendations): Discover recommended papers, researchers, and topics based on activity.

## Community and Collaboration
- [Questions Directory](https://www.researchgate.net/questions): Community Q&A for discussing methods, findings, and research problems.
- [Projects](https://www.researchgate.net/project): Project pages for organizing research work and collaborators.
- [Research Interests](https://www.researchgate.net/topics): Topic-based discovery and following of research interests.
- [Updates](https://www.researchgate.net/updates): Feed of research activity, publications, and network updates for signed-in users.
- [Messages](https://www.researchgate.net/messages): Direct messaging interface for communicating with other members.

## Jobs and Institutions
- [Jobs Search](https://www.researchgate.net/jobs): Browse research, faculty, and academic industry job listings.
- [Institution Directory](https://www.researchgate.net/institution): Directory of universities, institutes, and research organizations.
- [Institution Search](https://www.researchgate.net/search/institution): Search for institutions by name and location.
- [Department Pages](https://www.researchgate.net/department): Explore departments and subunits within institutions.
- [Lab Pages](https://www.researchgate.net/lab): View lab pages and associated researchers or projects.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://help.researchgate.net/): Official support portal for account, publication, and platform questions.
- [Help Home](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us): Entry page for ResearchGate help articles and support topics.
- [Getting Started](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us/categories/200217417-Getting-Started): Help articles for account setup and initial platform use.
- [Profiles](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us/categories/200217427-Profiles): Support documentation for profile management and researcher identity.
- [Publications](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us/categories/200217407-Publications): Help articles covering publication records, uploads, and full-text sharing.
- [Questions](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us/categories/200217437-Questions): Guidance for asking, answering, and managing research questions.
- [Jobs](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us/categories/360001496639-Jobs): Support content for job search and job-related platform features.
- [Technical Support](https://help.researchgate.net/hc/en-us/categories/200217447-Technical-Support): Troubleshooting articles for login, notifications, and technical issues.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.researchgate.net/terms-of-service): Terms governing use of the ResearchGate platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.researchgate.net/privacy-policy): Privacy practices for account data, content, and platform usage.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.researchgate.net/cookie-policy): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used by ResearchGate.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.researchgate.net/community-guidelines): Rules and expectations for participation on the platform.
- [Copyright](https://www.researchgate.net/copyright): Copyright information and policies related to shared research content.
- [Imprint](https://www.researchgate.net/imprint): Legal notice and company identification information.

## Business and Institutional Solutions
- [Advertising](https://www.researchgate.net/advertising): Information about advertising opportunities on ResearchGate.
- [Recruiting Solutions](https://www.researchgate.net/recruiting): Hiring and talent outreach solutions for employers and institutions.
- [Institutional Solutions](https://www.researchgate.net/institutional-solutions): Information for institutions engaging with researchers on the platform.
- [Partnerships](https://www.researchgate.net/partnerships): Partnership opportunities and collaboration information for organizations.
- [Contact](https://www.researchgate.net/contact): Contact options for support, business, and general inquiries.
